Increases damage against shielded targets:
• #e${125+#d}% increase against PVE Combatant Overshields
• #e${50+#f}% increase against PVE Combatant Elemental Shields, <barrier/>Barrier Champion Shields, and Subjugator <link Bosses [#CombatantClassifications] />
• #e${20+#g}% increase against Player Overshields and for bodyshots against Players with <strand/>Woven Mail

Notable Combatant Overshields include Shadow Legion <link Tech Pack [https://www.destinypedia.com/Tech_Pack] /> and Lucent Moth Overshields. They are indicated with a glowing outline around the targets as well as a small blue health bar under the normal one.
